method: One-by-one visual review of the exact saved CJ product pages in the Codex browser, including original-size product assets and actual-product photographs; no CJ search API.

products.reason: The selected rust-orange and slate-blue corduroy shacket has a complete product-only front, readable regular fit, full hem and cuffs, a useful brighter Fall palette and a true texture-detail backup. It is imported locally as an unassigned source candidate; it is not catalog-approved, reserved or outfit-approved.
products.selectedColor: rust orange and slate blue color-block (CJ UI label: Blue)

products.reason: Reject. The polished model images present a clean knit blazer, but the listing's own actual-product photographs reveal thin fleece-like cloth, weak lapel structure, crude patch pockets and poor drape. The real garment does not meet the Zara-led quality bar and cannot be rescued without redesigning it.

The selected Green JK1005 short utility jacket has a complete 800 by 800 worn front with readable collar, snap placket, pockets, sleeves and hem. Black and khaki images were excluded from refinement to prevent color drift, and three unrelated 1188 track-jacket images bundled under the same CJ page were explicitly excluded. It remains an unassigned local source candidate until a complete outfit board passes.
